# Interest

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A note capturing an ongoing topic of curiosity or attention that is not (yet) an active Project or Area of responsibility.

## Scope note

Distinguish from Area (ongoing responsibility) and Project (bounded effort with an end state), per PARA-style organization.
